list.comment:
feat(core): 添加检测分析核心功能模块
- 新增Analyzer类用于行为序列分析、告警系统和考勤统计功能 - 添加Det类实现YOLO模型检测功能，支持图像和视频检测任务 - 实现检测结果可视化绘制功能，包括边界框标注和置信度显示 - 添加视频捕获和帧处理功能，支持实时检测和批量分析 - 集成训练参数配置文件，包含YOLOv8和YOLOv11模型配置 - 添加训练结果CSV数据记录，包含损失函数和评估指标跟踪 - 实现OpenCV显示工具，支持图像和视频流展示功能

feat(auth): implement authentication and authorization system
- Added public and protected routers with custom OAuth2 bearer token handling - Implemented login, registration, and captcha generation endpoints - Created secure user info endpoint with token validation dependency - Updated authorization logic to include custom token validation and error handling - Modified logging retention periods for server and error logs - Refactored YOLO model path references to correctly locate model files - Removed obsolete login and secure API route files - Added simpel-captcha dependency for captcha generation functionality
